system.description:
The shell carries a built-in (or builton) weapon. This weapon mount may be either internal (concealed, only weapons small in relation to the shell may fit, –30 to Perception Tests to detect) or external (visible). It may be fixed (one direction only), swiveling (limited field of fire), or on an articulated mount (all directions).

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 311.
